title: Cross-Chain ETH Arbitrage: Ethereum to Arbitrum to Optimism
narrative: A three-agent team coordinates a cross-chain arbitrage opportunity. The analyzer detects a 1.5% ETH price difference between Ethereum ($2,850) and Arbitrum ($2,892). The capital allocator provides 50 ETH from the shared treasury, withdrawing from Aave supply. The executor bridges the ETH from Ethereum to Arbitrum via the canonical bridge, swaps it on Arbitrum DEXes, and routes remaining value through Optimism for an additional leg. Profits are split proportionally after accounting for gas costs, bridge fees, and slippage. This scenario tests cross-chain coordination, time-sensitive decision making, and multi-hop arbitrage execution.

agents.mission: Detect and validate cross-chain price discrepancies across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Optimism with minimum 1.0% net profit threshold after all costs
Allocate capital efficiently for arbitrage opportunities with minimum 0.8% ROI per trade and strict loss limits (max -0.3% per failed trade)
Execute arbitrage trades with minimum slippage and optimal bridge selection, completing full cycle within 30 minutes

trigger_event.description: ETH priced at $2,850 on Ethereum (Uniswap V3) vs $2,892 on Arbitrum (Balancer) — price discrepancy of 1.47%. Gas estimate: 0.05 ETH for bridge and swaps. Bridge time: ~12 minutes via canonical Arbitrum bridge.
trigger_event.onchain_evidence: Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC price oracle 0x8ad599c3 at block 19930000; Balancer Arbitrum ETH/USDC pool price query at Arbitrum L2 block 89200000

expected_coordination_flow.action: Detect price discrepancy: poll Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC on Ethereum ($2,850.20) and Balancer ETH/USDC on Arbitrum ($2,892.10) → calculate 1.47% spread
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:Opportunity → {type:arb, pair:ETH_USDC, chains:[Ethereum,Arbitrum], spread:1.47percent, net_estimate:0.92percent, timestamp:T+0min}

expected_coordination_flow.action: Assess net profitability: 1.47% spread - 0.2% bridge fee - 0.05% swap slippage - 0.3% gas = ~0.92% net → exceeds minimum 0.8% threshold
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Opportunity viable — publish recommendation for capital allocation

expected_coordination_flow.action: Review analysis from shared KG → validate ETH price feeds across both chains → approve 50 ETH allocation
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Withdraw 50 ETH from Aave V3 Ethereum supply → transfer to executor wallet address

data_shared.source: Aave V3 Ethereum (withdrawn from 100 ETH supply)

expected_coordination_flow.action: Receive 50 ETH from capital_allocator → initiate bridge via Arbitrum canonical bridge (L1→L2 standard gateway) → submit transaction and wait for L2 confirmation (~12 min)
Bridge confirmed on Arbitrum side → execute swap: 50 ETH → ~144,600 USDC on Balancer Arbitrum at $2,892 (target) → route through 2 pools for optimal pricing
Swap complete (144,362 USDC received after 0.16% slippage) → check Optimism ETH price ($2,900) → calculate additional leg: bridge USDC to Optimism + swap to ETH = estimated +0.25% net profit
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Route through Optimism for additional arbitrage leg — expected increment: +0.25% net

expected_coordination_flow.action: Bridge USDC to Optimism via Across Protocol (~8 min) → swap USDC → ETH on Uniswap V3 Optimism at $2,900 → receive ~49.5 ETH after all costs
Complete full cycle: return 50 ETH principal + 1.17 ETH net profit to capital_allocator → settle profit split per agreement

coordination_efficiency.description: Steps from price discrepancy detection to profit distribution across 3 specialized agents

consensus_latency.description: Time from first detection to capital allocation approval by capital_allocator

communication_overhead.description: Messages exchanged between analyzer, capital_allocator, and executor

system_resilience.description: What happens when bridge from Ethereum to Arbitrum is delayed beyond 30 minutes (market moves against the position)

scale.1: Executor waits indefinitely — opportunity window closes, capital remains locked in bridge, net loss on gas
scale.3: Executor waits 30 min then aborts — capital returned but 0.02 ETH gas wasted on failed bridge attempt
scale.5: Executor monitors bridge status with automated timeout — after 20 min delay, triggers abort sequence, returns capital to capital_allocator. Total loss limited to 0.01 ETH gas, within risk parameters
